name: tradrl-adapters-crypto
description: Crypto provider adapter baseline (W026): provider descriptors for real crypto exchanges (Binance Spot, Coinbase Exchange) with declared symbol mappings, polling/fidelity declarations and per-feed record mappers turning exchange-native public REST record shapes into W020 HistoricalRecord sets + dataset descriptors. Fixture-based — NO live network IO (the live fetch layer is a later work order). Deterministic pure transforms only (A9).
